app.name: Noto
app.tagline: Your files, your tools, one space.

nav.privacyNote: Your files stay on this device

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make Noto yours.
settings.lineNumbersDesc: Find your way in the file.
settings.windowsDesc: Stay in control of default apps.
settings.defaultAppsDesc: Noto can be suggested for supported formats. Windows lets you choose without silent replacement.
settings.immersiveDesc: Double-click an associated file or “Open with”: the document appears alone without sidebar, menus or tabs. Esc or Ctrl+Shift+F restores interface.
settings.backupDesc: Export or import groups and settings; paths included, never file contents.
settings.restoreSessionDesc: Keep open tab paths on this device without storing content.
settings.draftRecoveryDesc: Saves unsaved edits locally for text files. Off by default; 750k chars limit per file. Turning off clears drafts after confirmation.
settings.draftRetentionDesc: Older drafts are removed on next access.
settings.hidePathsDesc: Replace visible paths with discreet label.
settings.resetDesc: Restore default visual and editor settings.
settings.autoUpdateDesc: Automatically look for a new version.
settings.searchIndexDesc: A local index to instantly find your files.
settings.thanksText: Noto is imagined and developed by Louis — Louxos, founder of Louxos Corporation, with the Louxos Corporation collective. Thanks to everyone who tests, reports and supports the project.
settings.privacy: Your documents and groups stay on this device. Text drafts are kept locally only if recovery is enabled; disabling it clears them.

home.title: Your files, in clarity.
home.subtitle: Open a document, find it, organize it — without leaving Noto.
home.noRecent: No recent files. Open a document to see it here.
home.atelierDesc: Process, convert and analyze your files locally
home.recentSubtitle: Pick up where you left off.

recents.description: Files you have recently opened on this device.
